Words, meanings, and sources.

Definitions are selected from dictionaries for the senses relevant to this emotion chart. A word may have other meanings; there is no single “official” definition of a feeling. Every definition identifies its source and part of speech. Where the dictionary supplies a base verb, that form is identified explicitly.

Emotion word lists

Word lists and family groupings are credited to Kids Mental Health Tools, transcribed from the supplied feelings chart.

Princeton WordNet 3.0

Princeton University. “About WordNet.” WordNet. Princeton University. Selected glosses from WordNet 3.0 are reproduced with their original wording; accompanying examples are omitted. Each entry's synset identifier is recorded in definitions.json. The dataset was obtained from the NLTK WordNet distribution.
